description: Change the shared memory (a tree of folders and .json files; same paths as the memory tool, keep the file extension). Each op also updates the index, so never edit _index.json yourself. Every add needs three things: path, description (one line shown in the index) and value; add without description fails. To save a new fact: if its folder is not listed yet, make the folder first: {"op":"add","path":"notes/","description":"Notes about people"} ; then {"op":"add","path":"notes/amy.json","description":"Who Amy is","value":"Amy likes tea."} . Change it: {"op":"set","path":"notes/amy.json","value":"Amy likes coffee."} (description optional). Delete it: {"op":"rm","path":"notes/amy.json"} (a folder that is not empty needs "recursive":true). A key inside a .json object: {"op":"add","path":"notes/people.json#/bob","description":"Who Bob is","value":{"likes":"tea"}} (make notes/people.json first with value {}). A folder's own description is its _description.json and an object's is its _description key: write them like any path with a string value and no description, e.g. {"op":"add","path":"notes/_description.json","value":"Notes about people."} . value is plain text or any JSON; do not put JSON inside a string. Keep one text under 2 KB. Errors: ArgumentsBad (add without description: the line shows the call to make), NodeExists (use set), NodeMissing (the line says what exists and what to add first), ValueBad, PathBad (bad path, or rm the root), ChildrenExist, TargetBad, WriteFailed (the file system does not let you write there).

op.description: add = create something new; set = change something that exists; rm = delete

path.description: Like notes/amy.json, notes/amy.json#/phone or notes/trips/ (ends with / = a folder). Relative to the memory root; copy paths as the memory tool prints them.

description.description: REQUIRED for every add (except _description.json and _description keys): one line saying what this is, shown in the index. Optional for set; not used by rm.

value.description: add (not for a folder) and set: the content. Plain text is a string like "Amy likes tea."; any other JSON is stored as JSON. For a file that is not .json it must be a string. At most 8000 bytes.

recursive.description: rm: also delete a folder that is not empty.
